scenario_description:
Objective: Finish the in-progress slotted name-badge assembly for today’s poll-worker orientation check-in box.
Emerging Need: The badge table starts producing usable cards, then the only checked-out slot punch locks shut and leaves the remaining badge cards without the slots needed to attach their lanyards.
Decision Context: The packing window is short, ordinary cutting is not acceptable for these cards, and a stored supply record identifies whether an approved spare can still be released.
Consequence: Clearing the blockage promptly could preserve the started assembly for check-in; after the release route closes, the remaining badges cannot be made ready for that orientation.

parameter.title: Poll-worker orientation check-in badge assembly
parameter.description: Prepare 86 slotted cardstock name badges and lanyards for today's 13:15 poll-worker orientation check-in; packed check-in box closes at 12:50.

parameter.content: Badge table is underway: the blue section is done, 22 cards are slotted and clipped to lanyards, and I am feeding the green batch next. Check-in box still goes downstairs before 12:50.

parameter.subject: Badge punch logged out to training room
parameter.body: For today's orientation badge assembly, the BG-1 slotted-card punch tag is logged to the training room table under the activity name. The remaining cardstock badge sheets are still staged there; no second punch is checked out with that kit.

parameter.content: The BG-1 punch has locked shut with a badge blank inside. I cleared loose paper, but the feed arm will not move. The remaining badge cards have no slots and cannot attach to the lanyards, so assembly has stopped.

parameter.subject: Training-room sweep has closed supply releases
parameter.body: Security has started the pre-orientation sweep, so Annex supply releases are now closed until after the 13:15 check-in period. The check-in box still moves downstairs with only already slotted badges included.
